caption: The drawing depicts a woman in profile wearing a long, black, Victorian-style dress with a full skirt and three-quarter length sleeves. The dress features a decorative trim composed of a zigzag pink and white border with black lace along the edges of the sleeves, neckline, and hem. A sash or bow, matching the trim, appears at the back of the waist. The woman wears a large, wide-brimmed black hat adorned with a thick white feather. Her hair is styled in a chin-length bob, and her visible hand is bare. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller illustration of the same woman and dress, this time shown facing forward, with the same black and pink color scheme and accessories. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color. The artist's name, "Edith Isaacs," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll--"Belle Hervey"
